spans.s:
m. (-लः)
1 A shakal or jackal.
2 A coward, a poltroon.
3 A rogue, a cheat.
4 An ill-natured or harsh-speaking man.
5 A demon so named.
6 KṚṢṆA.
f. (-ली)
1 Flight, retreat.
2 A fox.
3 A she jackal.
E.
शृज to create or abandon, (deceit, &c.) कालन् aff., or शृंग a horn, अ negative prefix, ला to possess, aff. क, deriv. irr.; also सृगाल, &c.

m. (-लः)
1 A jackal.
2 A Daitya or demon.
E.
सृज to let go, कालन् aff.; more usually शृगाल.

m. (-कः)
A plant, commonly Seyālkānta or jackal's thorn, (Zizyphus scandens.)
E.
शृगाल, and कण्टक a thorn.

m. (-लिः)
A sort of jujube.
E.
शृगाल a jackal, and कोलि the jujube.

f. (-म्बूः)
1 A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus.)
2 The fruit of the jujube.
E.
शृगाल a jackal, and जम्बू roseapple.

f. (-का)
1 The female jackal.
2 A fox.
3 Running away, flight, retreat.
4 A plant, (Convolvulus paniculatus.)
E.
शृगाली as above, and कन् added.

m. (-गा)
A short arrow, thrown with the hand or shot through a tube.
E.
सृ to go, aff. गक्.
